triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Grushenka lived in the busiest part of the town, near the cathedral square, in a small wooden lodge in the courtyard belonging to the house of the widow Morozov.

triples.subject: Kuzma Kuzmitch Samsonov
triples.quote: she had taken in Grushenka as a lodger, four years before, solely to please her kinsman, the merchant Samsonov, who was known to be the girl’s protector.

triples.subject: Kuzma Kuzmitch Samsonov
triples.quote: It was said, however, that though Grushenka had been raised from destitution by the old man, Samsonov, she came of a respectable family

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: “You are a wench with brains,” he said to her, when he gave her eight thousand roubles, “and you must look after yourself

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: When Fyodor Pavlovitch, who first came into contact with Grushenka over a piece of speculation, ended to his own surprise by falling madly in love with her

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Of late, when Dmitri too had come on the scene with his love, the old man left off laughing.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: grotesque and monstrous rivalry of the Karamazovs, father and son, the object of which was Grushenka

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: many in our town knew of the grotesque and monstrous rivalry of the Karamazovs, father and son, the object of which was Grushenka

triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: Fenya, fetch him a candle.... Well, you have chosen a moment to bring him!” she exclaimed again

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: I did insult her dreadfully. She sent for me, she wanted to make a conquest of me, to win me over with her chocolate....

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: You see, I love him with all my soul, that’s how it is! Alyosha, do you believe I love you with all my soul?

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: His elder died to-day, Father Zossima, the saint.

triples.subject: Matryona
triples.quote: I used to hear it when I was a child from Matryona, my cook, who is still with me.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Take it. Rakitin, I owe it you, there’s no fear of your refusing it, you asked for it yourself.

triples.subject: Mihail Osipovitch Rakitin
triples.quote: He put the twenty-five rouble note in his pocket and he felt ashamed at Alyosha’s seeing it.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Hush, Rakitin, you know nothing about us! And don’t dare to speak to me like that again.

triples.subject: Mihail Osipovitch Rakitin
triples.quote: You were so primed up with your elder’s teaching last night that now you have to let it off on me, Alexey, man of God!” said Rakitin, with a smile of hatred.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: Agrafena Alexandrovna, our monk’s really in love with you, you’ve made a conquest!” he cried, with a coarse laugh.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Alyosha, give my greetings to your brother Mitya and tell him not to remember evil against me, though I have brought him misery.

triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: Fenya ran noisily into the room, crying out: “Mistress, mistress darling, a messenger has galloped up,” she cried, breathless and joyful.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: And add, too, that Grushenka loved him only one hour, only one short hour she loved him—so let him remember that hour all his life—say, ‘Grushenka tells you to!’”

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Agrafena Alexandrovna, our monk’s really in love with you, you’ve made a conquest!” he cried, with a coarse laugh.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: You shall black my shoes, Rakitin, that’s the place you are fit for. You’ll never get a woman like me ... and he won’t either, perhaps ...

triples.subject: Mihail Osipovitch Rakitin
triples.quote: “Damnation take you all and each of you!” he cried suddenly, “why the devil did I take you up? I don’t want to know you from this time forward. Go alone, there’s your road!”

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: “It’s time we were off,” he said, “it’s late, we shall be shut out of the monastery.”

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Grushenka snatched the letter from her and carried it to the candle. It was only a note, a few lines. She read it in one instant.
